## Summary

What changed?

## Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] New module
- [ ] New renderer
- [ ] New preset
- [ ] Docs / tooling

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant package build passes
- [ ] Demo build passes, if affected
- [ ] Benchmarks run or performance impact is explained, if relevant
- [ ] Docs or examples updated, if user-facing

## Notes

Anything reviewers should pay special attention to?


### Example / Preset Changes

Applies when adding or substantially changing particle examples.

- [ ] Implementation is canonical in `examples/` and works in the demo.
- [ ] Metadata and documentation source regions are complete and valid.
- [ ] The example guide was generated or updated.
- [ ] System, emitter, module, and renderer choices and important values are explained.
- [ ] Visual previews were inspected where applicable, with backend results reported.
- [ ] `npm run docs:generate` and `npm run docs:check` pass; generated artifacts are included.
